task: Open the point cloud /home/user/Documents/scan_binary.ply in CloudCompare. Create an ASCII-encoded PLY version of this point cloud and save it as: /home/user/Documents/scan_ascii.ply. The output must represent the same point cloud, preserving all 500 points and associated attributes.
task_grounding: Open the point cloud /home/user/Documents/scan_binary.ply in CloudCompare. It is currently a binary PLY file with 500 points. Use File > Save As and save the exact same cloud as an ASCII PLY at /home/user/Documents/scan_ascii.ply. When the PLY export dialog asks for a file type, choose the ASCII PLY encoding. Do not modify the point data — only the file format should change.

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CloudCompare CLI: cli-anything-cloudcompare export cloud INDEX output.ply --preset ply [--overwrite]
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI has 'export cloud' command supporting multiple formats (PLY binary/ASCII, LAS, XYZ, etc.) with format-specific options.
